summary: Adeline Software's Little Big Adventure/Twinsen series mixes isometric exploration, puzzle solving, and action, with current classic, enhanced, and full-remake routes that must be labeled separately.

entries.title: Little Big Adventure
entries.definitive_edition: Twinsen's Little Big Adventure Classic Original Edition on Steam/GOG

primary.version: Twinsen's Little Big Adventure Classic / Original Edition
primary.why: The current Steam/GOG classic route preserves the original 1994 PC game through DOSBox/original-edition access, while the Enhanced Edition and Twinsen's Quest remake change controls, interface, visuals, music, and mechanics. For the archive target, the classic/original route is the baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG Classic route and select/document the Original Edition when fidelity matters. Record storefront/build, DOSBox/original versus Enhanced route, controls, language, save/checkpoint state, region/title variant, and whether Twinsen's Quest was sampled as a remake comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: Redesigned interface, controller support, checkpoints, zoom, and simplified mechanics
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the modernized classic route.
secondary.why: It improves access but changes the original behavior.

secondary.exclusive_content: Full remake with new visuals, music, and smoother gameplay
secondary.what_to_play: Archive separately as a remake/comparison route.
secondary.why: It is not a replacement for the 1994 original.
The PC original/classic route is the main archive target.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Enhanced Edition and Twinsen's Quest remake improve accessibility but are not exact substitutes for the 1994 DOS/PC game.
